facts.raw_span: A 47-year-old Caucasian woman
23-year history of presumed multiple sclerosis
four episodes of optic neuritis since 1989
longitudinally extensive transverse myelitis in 1995
persistently negative cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) oligoclonal bands
unremarkable brain MRI scans
subacute onset of expressive aphasia and right-sided hemiparesis
expressive language impairment and 3/5 strength in the right arm and leg
normal complete blood count and metabolic panel
large T2-hyperintense, tumefactive lesion in the left prefrontal white matter
serum aquaporin-4 antibody titre was 1:1000 by cell-based assay
no evidence of intrathecal immunoglobulin synthesis, no oligoclonal bands, and a normal cell count
